summary: Phase-1 continuation (BUG-30/31/35 + SENSEX preset) verified end-to-end against the live preview. All backend contract tests (9/9) pass via pytest against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; the frontend /infra-health and /option-chain UI both render the new panels/presets correctly with live Kite data. The proxy cookie-jar auth bypass reported in iteration_1 has been fixed — anonymous /api/system/mode, /api/system/reconciliation, and /api/metrics all correctly return 401, and a second anonymous client after an admin login is NOT treated as authenticated. Mode-override HALT→null cycle exercised exactly once as instructed (no Telegram spam).

minor.issue: Global 300 req/min ratelimit is aggressive for browser boot: a hard-refresh of /option-chain shortly after other pages fires >100 concurrent XHRs (option chain 15s poll + kite/status + indices + ticker + telemetry) which can push the whole tenant to 429 for ~30s. Under 429 the SPA sometimes shows Cloudflare's human-check page instead of a graceful stale/backoff UI. Manifests as broken-looking first-paint on retries; not a functional regression.

action_items: Optional: add exponential backoff / request coalescing on the scanner boot path so a 429 storm doesn't cascade into Cloudflare's bot-challenge page for legitimate refreshes.
Optional: consider adding data-testid="quick-preset-SENSEX" (and siblings) on QUICK_PRESETS buttons — currently they are located only by role+text which works but is brittle.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/artifacts/api-server/src/routes/systemStatus.ts is clean: consistent requireOwner vs requireOwnerStrict split (GET = requireOwner, mutating POSTs = strict), correct 400 shape for invalid_mode with the exact allowed enum echoed back, metrics gated by Bearer-token OR owner cookie (no anonymous scrape path). No _id leak surface here.

runSystemModeTick() is invoked lazily inside GET /system/mode when snapshot is null — good; but it's also awaited inside /metrics under Promise.all which could re-trigger a DB ping every metrics scrape. Consider a short-TTL cache to avoid pathological scraper cadences.
/api/system/reconciliation/run returns 200 with the freshly persisted report; verified via subsequent GET (report for today's ist_date is present). No transaction/isolation issues surfaced.

rca of the issue: N/A for this iteration — no defects found. Iteration_1's proxy cookie leak has been confirmed fixed: (1) anon GET /api/auth/status returns authenticated:false BOTH before and after a separate client's admin login; (2) 3 owner-only endpoints uniformly return 401 for anonymous callers; (3) after login-cookie is set on client A, client B (no cookie) still receives 401 on /api/system/mode. The fix is holding under real traffic.
